decisions.quote: We accrue estimated costs of these insurance programs at the present value of projected settlements for known claims and incurred but not reported claims.

We are subject to various legal proceedings and claims, the outcomes of which are uncertain. We record an accrual for legal contingencies when we determine that it is probable that we have incurred a liability and we can reasonably estimate the amount of the loss.
We have been and are currently party to other legal proceedings involving claims that we infringe the intellectual property rights of others.
